name: Home Assistant — Zones
description: Who's home, who's away — auto-discovers every person.* entity in Home Assistant. Each row leads with the person's avatar (HA profile picture, or a coloured-initials circle keyed to their name when there's no picture) and right-aligns a zone-glyph (briefcase for work, graduation-cap for school, barbell for gym, etc.) + the zone label. One get_states call covers the whole household.
